sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Pulp mill row with Argentina deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: Argentine protesters blockade border bridges over mills on the shared Uruguay river.

geopolitical_news.headline: Vázquez's leftist government advances
geopolitical_news.summary: Tabaré Vázquez pushes tax and health reforms in the Frente Amplio's first term.

sport.headline: Uruguay misses the World Cup
sport.summary: A playoff defeat to Australia in 2005 keeps Uruguay out of Germany 2006.

geopolitical_news.headline: ICJ hears pulp mill case
geopolitical_news.summary: The Hague takes up Argentina's suit against Uruguay over the river mills.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trade deal with US signed
geopolitical_news.summary: A bilateral trade and investment framework pact deepens Uruguay's economic ties with Washington.

sport.headline: Copa América semi-final run
sport.summary: Uruguay finishes fourth in Venezuela; the under-20s impress at the World Cup.

geopolitical_news.headline: Vázquez popularity stays high
geopolitical_news.summary: The president maintains strong approval into his final years.

geopolitical_news.headline: Tax reform beds in
geopolitical_news.summary: The Frente Amplio's new personal income-tax system reshapes public finances and reduces inequality.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying push
sport.summary: Uruguay climbs the CONMEBOL table behind Forlán and Suárez.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mujica elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Ex-guerrilla José Mujica wins November's runoff for the Frente Amplio.

geopolitical_news.headline: Amnesty referendum fails
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters narrowly keep the law shielding dictatorship-era crimes from prosecution.

sport.headline: World Cup qualification via playoff
sport.summary: Uruguay beats Costa Rica over two legs to reach South Africa 2010.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mujica takes office
geopolitical_news.summary: The famously austere former Tupamaro guerrilla José Mujica becomes president in March 2010.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pulp mill deal with Argentina
geopolitical_news.summary: The neighbors agree joint monitoring of the river, easing the long dispute.

sport.headline: World Cup semi-final run
sport.summary: Uruguay finishes fourth; Forlán wins the Golden Ball and Suárez's handball stuns Ghana.

geopolitical_news.headline: Amnesty law repealed
geopolitical_news.summary: Congress scraps the amnesty law, reopening long-blocked prosecutions for dictatorship-era human rights crimes.

geopolitical_news.headline: Marijuana legalization proposed
geopolitical_news.summary: President Mujica unveils a pioneering plan for state-regulated cannabis production and retail sales.

sport.headline: Copa América champions
sport.summary: Uruguay beats Paraguay 3-0 for a record 15th continental title.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cannabis bill advances
geopolitical_news.summary: The lower house debates the pioneering cannabis legalization bill at length through the year.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mujica's fame grows
geopolitical_news.summary: The 'world's poorest president' becomes a global media phenomenon.

sport.headline: Olympic football campaign
sport.summary: Suárez leads Uruguay at the London games; the team exits early.

geopolitical_news.headline: Marijuana fully legalized
geopolitical_news.summary: Uruguay becomes the first country to legalize cannabis in December.

geopolitical_news.headline: Vázquez favored for 2014
geopolitical_news.summary: The ex-president leads polls for a return to office.

sport.headline: World Cup qualification via playoff
sport.summary: Uruguay thrashes Jordan 5-0 on aggregate in the playoff to book Brazil 2014.

geopolitical_news.headline: Vázquez re-elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: He beats Luis Lacalle Pou in November's runoff to return to the presidency.

geopolitical_news.headline: Guantánamo refugees arrive
geopolitical_news.summary: Uruguay resettles six former Guantánamo detainees on humanitarian grounds in a December transfer.

sport.headline: World Cup last-16 exit
sport.summary: Suárez is banned for biting Chiellini; Colombia knocks Uruguay out.

geopolitical_news.headline: Vázquez begins second term
geopolitical_news.summary: He takes office in March promising continuity with a moderate touch.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cannabis sales delayed
geopolitical_news.summary: Pharmacy sales of legal marijuana are pushed back amid regulatory wrangling.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final exit
sport.summary: Uruguay loses to hosts Chile in a heated Santiago quarter-final, with Cavani sent off.

geopolitical_news.headline: Economy weathers regional storm
geopolitical_news.summary: Uruguay's stable economy outperforms its crisis-hit neighbors Argentina and Brazil this year.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ex-dictator Alvarez dies
geopolitical_news.summary: Gregorio Álvarez dies in December while serving time for dictatorship crimes.

sport.headline: Copa América group-stage exit
sport.summary: Uruguay suffers a shock early exit in the United States after group-stage defeats.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pharmacy marijuana sales begin
geopolitical_news.summary: Registered users can buy legal cannabis in pharmacies from July.

geopolitical_news.headline: UPM pulp mill deal
geopolitical_news.summary: The government signs an investment pact for a second giant mill.

sport.headline: World Cup qualification sealed
sport.summary: Uruguay books its Russia 2018 ticket with games to spare in qualifying.

geopolitical_news.headline: Election race takes shape
geopolitical_news.summary: Lacalle Pou emerges as the opposition frontrunner for 2019.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cannabis tourism debated
geopolitical_news.summary: Government officials weigh extending legal cannabis sales to the foreign tourists visiting Uruguay.

sport.headline: World Cup quarter-final run
sport.summary: Uruguay beats Portugal before falling to eventual champions France.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lacalle Pou elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: He narrowly beats Daniel Martínez in November's runoff, ending 15 years of leftist rule.

geopolitical_news.headline: Military reform referendum fails
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters reject Lacalle Pou's hardline military-backed security overhaul in the October plebiscite.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final exit
sport.summary: Uruguay loses to Peru on penalties in the Copa América quarter-finals in Brazil.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lacalle takes office
geopolitical_news.summary: He is inaugurated in March days before the pandemic hits.

geopolitical_news.headline: Uruguay praised for COVID response
geopolitical_news.summary: Low case counts make it a regional model early in the pandemic.

sport.headline: Football suspended by pandemic
sport.summary: Leagues and qualifiers halt; Tabárez's long reign nears its end.

geopolitical_news.headline: LUC referendum campaign
geopolitical_news.summary: The opposition gathers signatures to repeal parts of the flagship omnibus law.

geopolitical_news.headline: Vaccination campaign succeeds
geopolitical_news.summary: High COVID-19 vaccination rates allow Uruguay one of the region's earliest economic reopenings.

sport.headline: Tabárez sacked as coach
sport.summary: The historic 15-year tenure ends in November amid poor qualifying results.

geopolitical_news.headline: Government wins LUC referendum
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters back the omnibus law in March, a boost for Lacalle.

geopolitical_news.headline: Drug-trafficking scandals
geopolitical_news.summary: A passport-issuance scandal and contraband smuggling cases embarrass President Lacalle's struggling government.

sport.headline: World Cup group-stage exit
sport.summary: Uruguay goes out on goals scored; Suárez and Cavani bow out.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pension reform passed
geopolitical_news.summary: Congress raises the retirement age to 65 despite fierce union and leftist opposition.

geopolitical_news.headline: Water crisis hits Montevideo
geopolitical_news.summary: Severe drought forces brackish tap water on the capital in Montevideo's worst shortage on record.

sport.headline: Bielsa era begins brightly
sport.summary: Uruguay beats Brazil and Argentina in 2026 qualifying under the new coach.

geopolitical_news.headline: Orsi elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Yamandú Orsi wins November's runoff, returning the Frente Amplio to power.

geopolitical_news.headline: Plebiscites fail
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters reject pension and police-raid constitutional reforms in October.

sport.headline: Copa América third place
sport.summary: Uruguay beats Canada for bronze; Suárez retires from international football.

geopolitical_news.headline: Orsi takes office
geopolitical_news.summary: He is inaugurated in March promising dialogue and social investment.

geopolitical_news.headline: Economy steadies
geopolitical_news.summary: The new government inherits stable growth and low inflation.

sport.headline: World Cup 2026 qualification secured
sport.summary: Uruguay books its ticket with games to spare under Bielsa.
